text:
Zoe Lin: hey team — tiny celebratory update: got promoted to Lead Data Eng AND we just welcomed a baby girl last night. sleep-deprived and elated ❤️🎈
Marcus Hall: DOUBLE CONGRATS!!! that's wild. want us to do a little desk drop of treats or cupcakes? :tada:
Anya Roberts: congrats Zoe!! name reveal??
Zoe Lin: her name is Nola Rae. middle name after my grandma. due date was yesterday but she decided to arrive early.
Kellen Park: Nola Rae — love it. can confirm cupcakes are the correct celebration utensil. vote: 1) vanilla buttercream 2) chocolate ganache 3) lemon
Marcus Hall: 2) chocolate ganache forever
Anya Roberts: 1) but also lemon for the lightness
snacks-bot: Poll created: "Nola's Cupcake Flavor" options: Vanilla, Chocolate, Lemon
calendar-bot: Event created: "Zoe - Welcome Nola (Cupcakes)" Tomorrow 3:30 PM - 20 minutes
Zoe Lin: thank you all. tiny request: no visit schedule needed — we're doing a relaxed drop-by at the office if folks want to say hi. also pumping space request: is the quiet room available?
Kellen Park: i'll reserve Quiet Room B for noon-2pm tomorrow for you. also bringing earplugs for the crying baby playlist joke.
Marcus Hall: group card? also quick baby gift poll: practical (diapers + wipes) or silly (onesies with puns)?
Anya Roberts: practical please. we can be silly later.
Marcus Hall: practical then — i'll start a card in #people-ops for contributions.
Zoe Lin: really appreciate it. if you want to drop a meal, do note dairy-free dinners work well.
Anya Roberts: recipe swap? also i volunteer to champion the meal train signups.
Marcus Hall: small PSA: congrats party logistics — cupcakes will be at reception table, please keep snacks away from the new plant in the lobby; it's on probation.
Kellen Park: celebrating both the promotion and baby? someone make a meme: "promoted & parented" badge.
Anya Roberts: i'll make a tiny sticker.
Zoe Lin: honestly i'm overwhelmed in the best way. thanks team <3
snacks-bot: Reminder: cupcakes poll closes in 4 hours.
